# workflow — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
Multi-step workflow commands that chain API calls for complete operations. Required flags are in the signature; `ocl workflow <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

### workflow token-research
Full token due diligence — price, security, holders, signals, optional launchpad
`ocl workflow token-research [options]`
- `--address <ADDRESS>` — Token contract address (use this OR --query)
- `--query <QUERY>` — Token symbol or name to search (use this OR --address)
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain (e.g. solana, ethereum, base)

### workflow smart-money
Smart money signals — aggregate signals by token, run per-token due diligence
`ocl workflow smart-money [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain (defaults to solana)

### workflow new-tokens
New token screening — MIGRATED launchpad scan + safety enrichment for top 10
`ocl workflow new-tokens [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain (defaults to solana)
- `--stage <STAGE>` — Launchpad stage: MIGRATED (default) or MIGRATING

### workflow wallet-analysis
Wallet analysis — 7d/30d performance, trading behaviour, recent activity
`ocl workflow wallet-analysis --address <ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain (defaults to solana)

### workflow portfolio
Portfolio check — balances, total value, 30d PnL overview
`ocl workflow portfolio --address <ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--chains <CHAINS>` — Comma-separated chains (defaults to all supported)
